name: pistachio-lemon spaghetti (practice)
messages: Hi! I want to describe a pasta dish and I need you to keep track of it.
It's spaghetti, 200 g for two people, with a pistachio pesto.
The pesto is 60 g of shelled pistachios, the zest and juice of one lemon, and 3 tbsp of olive oil.
I'd add garlic too, one clove.
By the way, did you watch the match yesterday?
Actually no, scrap the garlic, I don't want any.
Then stir in 100 g of fresh ricotta and a handful of mint leaves at the end.
Finish with plenty of black pepper. Thanks!
